title: fix(spec)!: EngineQueryOptionsSchema.fields and the RPC request's select refuse an empty projection, as their transport siblings do
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBSHirnFJasE7wztBSe558R2)_

Fixes #26954

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — the skills teach only a non-empty engine `fields` projection (`skills/objectstack-query/rules/filters.md:105`, `fields: ['id']`; `skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md:25` lists `fields` among the legal `find` option keys) and never an empty one, so no skill sentence goes false; the one transport data-read line, `skills/objectui/guides/data-integration.md:82` (`$select: ['name', 'email']`), stays true too.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:引擎侧四份「选哪些字段」的公开声明(`EngineQueryOptionsSchema.fields`、RPC 请求里已弃用的 `select`、旧版 `DataEngineQueryOptionsSchema.select`、向量检索请求的 `fields`)不再接受空数组和带空白名的数组,与 #26949 收窄的三份兄弟声明共用同一条规则(同一处定义,未复制)。
- 为什么改:兄弟声明已拒绝空投影,这四份仍写着「空也收」,按声明生成的客户端或 AI 作者会学到相反的规则。
- 风险与回滚:仓内没有任何运行时用这四份 schema 解析请求,线上请求零变化;受影响的只有仓外直接用这些导出 schema 解析、且发了空投影的代码。进程内 `engine.find(obj, { fields: [] })` 仍读全部列,不变。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/data/data-engine.zod.ts`(共享规则上移到 `EngineQueryOptionsSchema` 之前,以及四个成员)、`packages/spec/src/data/data-engine.test.ts`(新 describe 块)、`.changeset/26954-engine-projection-empty.md`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/data/data-engine.test.ts -t 'engine-side projection'`,预期 44 个用例全绿:空数组与空白名被拒且报错文字与兄弟声明一致,非空列表通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/data/data-engine.zod.ts`:
  - The projection rule block from #26949 (`PROJECTION_NAMES_NO_FIELD`, `TransportProjectionStringSchema`, `transportProjectionArray`, `PROJECTION_ACCEPT_SET` and its docblock) **moves** from just above the page-window block to just above `EngineQueryOptionsSchema`. It is not copied. It has to move: `RpcQueryOptionsSchema` is a non-lazy `EngineQueryOptionsSchema.extend(...)`, so importing the module runs the lazy factory before any later `const` is initialised (a TDZ `ReferenceError`). The docblock gains one paragraph that says so and names the four new readers.
  - `EngineQueryOptionsSchema.fields`: `z.array(FieldNodeSchema)` becomes `transportProjectionArray(FieldNodeSchema)`, the same construction as `QueryTransportParamsSchema.$select`.
  - `RpcQueryOptionsSchema.select` (`@deprecated`): `z.array(z.string())` becomes `transportProjectionArray(z.string())`, the same construction as `QueryTransportParamsSchema.select` and the arm `GetDataRequestSchema.select` reads.
  - Folded in at the seat's request (same file, same family, same ruling): `DataEngineQueryOptionsSchema.select` (`@deprecated` legacy options) and `DataEngineVectorFindRequestSchema.fields` (the `vectorFind` arm of `DataEngineRequestSchema`). Both change from `z.array(z.string())` to `transportProjectionArray(z.string())`.
- `packages/spec/src/data/data-engine.test.ts`: one new `describe` block (44 cases), described under Tests.
- `.changeset/26954-engine-projection-empty.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch, with both declaration lines, one ADR-0087 marker and a BREAKING banner with Before / Now / Unchanged.

No `.describe()` changes. None of the four members had one, and `check:generated` reports all 14 artifacts up to date on the head, so no reference page regenerates. A sentence saying "is refused" would also be false of the in-process engine (see Acceptance notes).

**The ADR-0049 note** on `DataEngineRequestSchema` ("every arm below now has zero readers in this repo … an ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove candidate") is unchanged. I re-measured it on this head: no code outside `packages/spec` parses `DataEngineRequestSchema`, `DataEngineFindRequestSchema`, `DataEngineFindOneRequestSchema` or `DataEngineContractSchema` (`git grep`, non-test: the hits outside `data-engine.zod.ts` are the generated reference page's import line, the export ledgers and CHANGELOG prose). So every sentence in it is still true. The note moved down by 33 lines with the block.

## Why

After #26817 and #26909, every published transport declaration of a read's projection refuses an empty one. These four engine-side declarations still admitted `[]` and blank names, so a client generated from their JSON Schema, or an AI author reading them, learned the opposite rule. Seat ruling on #26954: align, do not retire.

## Readers and producers (measured on `origin/main` 3217fc5d)

- **Runtime parsers:** none, for any of the four members. `EngineQueryOptionsSchema` is read at runtime only for its key list (`runtime/src/action-execution.ts:2047`, `.shape` keys) and by objectql's `engine-unknown-option.test.ts` (keys). Key sets do not change. `RpcQueryOptionsSchema` is module-private and reached only through the three request schemas above, which have no parser outside spec. `DataEngineQueryOptionsSchema` and `DataEngineVectorFindRequestSchema` have no reference outside `packages/spec` except the generated reference page's import line and one prose sentence in `content/docs/kernel/contracts/data-engine.mdx:637`, which names the legacy schema as deprecated and is still true.
- **In-process engine:** `ObjectQL.find` / `findOne` never parse their options with this schema. `engine.ts:13563` projects only when `ast.fields.length > 0`, and `:13573` falls back to `*` on an empty projection. So `engine.find(obj, { fields: [] })` reads every column, as before.
- **Types:** `z.input` / `z.infer` stay `string[]` for all four members, so no TypeScript caller changes. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` passes on the head.
- **Client SDK / codegen / OpenAPI:** `packages/client` imports none of these schemas. JSON Schema gains `minItems: 1` and a per-item `\S` pattern. Both are a `min_length` and a `string_format`, not `custom`, so there is no `dropped-refinements` row. `api-surface`, `declaration-map`, `export-origins` and `authorable-surface` are key- or export-level and unchanged (`check:generated`: 14/14 up to date). `gen:openapi` is ungated.
- **In-repo callers sending `[]`:** none. `git grep` over `packages`, `ui`, `examples`, `apps` and `skills` (non-test) for `fields: []` / `select: []`: every hit is UI, flow, analytics or result metadata, not an engine query.
- **Stored or authored data:** none of the four members is authorable metadata. No metadata type embeds `EngineQueryOptionsSchema`, `DataEngineQueryOptionsSchema` or the request schemas (`git grep` over `packages/spec/src`). The authored projection is `QuerySchema.fields` (views, reports), which this PR does not touch. So `Metadata-protocol: none`, and ADR-0087 is `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

## Tests

`packages/spec/src/data/data-engine.test.ts`, `describe('the engine-side projection declarations admit exactly what their transport siblings admit')`:

- `EngineQueryOptionsSchema.fields` refuses `[]`, `['name', '']` and `['name', '  ']`. The issue path is `['fields']` or `['fields', 1]`. The message equals the one `QueryTransportParamsSchema.$select` gives for the same value, and that sibling's path is asserted too. It keeps `['name']` and `['name', 'email']` unchanged.
- For each of `DataEngineFindRequestSchema`, `DataEngineFindOneRequestSchema` and the `DataEngineRequestSchema` union:
  - `query.select` refuses the same three values at `['query', 'select', …]`, with the bare `select` sibling's message;
  - `query.fields` refuses them at `['query', 'fields', …]`, with `$select`'s message;
  - `query.select: ['name']` / `['name', 'email']` parses and folds onto `fields`.
- `DataEngineQueryOptionsSchema.select` refuses the same three values at `['select', …]`, with the bare `select` sibling's message, and keeps a non-empty list unchanged.
- `DataEngineVectorFindRequestSchema` and the `DataEngineRequestSchema` union (`method: 'vectorFind'`): `fields` refuses the three values at `['fields', …]`, with the bare `select` sibling's message, and keeps a non-empty list unchanged.

Ablation, after committing the fix, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit, blob moved, restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty):
- `fields` back to `z.array(FieldNodeSchema)`: 12 failed / 17 passed in the block.
- `select` back to `z.array(z.string())`: 9 failed / 20 passed.
- On `ba848653` (the 44-case block): `DataEngineQueryOptionsSchema.select` reverted gives 3 failed / 41 passed; `DataEngineVectorFindRequestSchema.fields` reverted gives 6 failed / 38 passed. Both restored to the HEAD blob, with `git diff HEAD` empty.

Runs on head `ba848653`:
- `@objectstack/spec` full suite under the lock: 819 files, 23498 tests passed (1 todo). Then `typecheck` (tsc, scripts and test typecheck): `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build && check:generated`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, and all 14 generated artifacts are up to date, so nothing was regenerated.
- Full dogfood, owed by the `(narrowing)` arm: built the `@objectstack/dogfood^...` closure, then ran `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock with no shard and no path. Result: 344 files passed, 3 skipped (347); 2784 tests passed, 20 skipped (2804); `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 80 derived families. All 80 exit 0. Three of them (`check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`) first exited 3 because their prerequisite was not met. They were run again after the dogfood closure build and exited 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 80 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
- The first head, `17ce2dfb`, had the same readings: 23483 spec tests, 80/80 gates, and the same dogfood counts.

## Acceptance notes

- **The declaration is narrower than the in-process engine, by design.** `engine.find(obj, { fields: [] })` still reads every column, because the engine does not parse its options. Everything the new declaration admits, the engine accepts. Nothing the engine does contradicts a sentence in this diff. No `.describe()` claims "is refused".
- **The two sibling members first reported here as left loose** (`DataEngineQueryOptionsSchema.select`, `DataEngineVectorFindRequestSchema.fields`) are aligned in this PR, at the seat's request.
- The in-process engine reading `fields: []` as every column is runtime behaviour outside this card. The seat filed it as #27008.

## Human Minimum

Each item is one rule from
[CONTRIBUTING.md › Human Minimum](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#human-minimum),
which links the AGENTS.md text that states it.

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (No formatter ran. `pnpm lint` is CI's repo-wide run.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed (`check:generated`: none were stale).
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
